definitions.explanation: A colloquial clipping of {炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ} (carbohydrate), used mainly in dieting and fitness talk to refer to carb-rich foods such as rice, bread, and noodles.

examples.japanese: {炭水|たんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{炭水|たんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to cut down on carbs at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{炭水|たんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜く：02384_nuku⟧すぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Many people cut carbs while dieting, but cutting too much is bad for the body.

notes:
A casual shortening of ⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧, common in conversation about diet and exercise. In formal or written contexts use the full word ⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭水|たんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to cut out carbs
- {炭水|たんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧: to go easy on carbs
- {炭水|たんすい}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧: a low-carb diet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧: carbohydrate — the full, standard term.
